title: pose-telemetry-bridge
pitch: Streams pose-tracking data to web games via WebSocket with a stable, typed message schema.
keyFeatures: WebSocket server/client helpers with reconnect and buffering
Smoothing and rate-limiting utilities for jittery pose streams
Debug overlay feed (FPS, dropped frames, latency)
targetUsers: Web/game developers who need reliable real-time pose/telemetry transport into Three.js/React frontends.
